test_collision_driver: test the collision driver by comparing mujoco_warp collision results against classic MuJoCo for various geometry pairs
test_sdf_collision: test sdf plugin-based collision detection between nut and bolt geometries using mujoco_warp
test_hfield_collision: test heightfield collision detection with box and mesh geometries using mujoco_warp
test_contact_pair: test contact pair configuration including margin, gap, friction, solref, solimp, and exclude rules
test_collision_disableflags: test collision detection behavior when constraint and contact disable flags are set
